title: MISGENDERMENDER: A Community-Informed Approach to Interventions for Misgendering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating NLP systems (including LLMs and rule-based models) on their ability to detect and correct misgendering (such as the use of incorrect pronouns, deadnames, or inappropriate gendered terms) in social media posts and language model generations about non-cisgender (transgender and non-binary) public figures, utilizing the custom MISGENDERMENDER annotated dataset and individual gender linguistic profiles.
